jobs.title: Pitch us a role
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

Lorikeet is redefining what customer support looks like — and we're just getting started.

We build AI that handles complex, high-volume support for fintechs, healthtechs, marketplaces, and delivery services. Not chatbot-tier AI. The kind that actually resolves tickets, gives support teams their time back, and raises the bar for what software can do.

We're backed by over $50M USD from QED, Blackbird, and Square Peg, with backing from operators like Claire Hughes Johnson (ex-Stripe COO) and Cristina Cordova (Linear COO), plus founders of Canva, Atlassian, and Airwallex. We're the first company since Canva to be funded at early stage by all three of Australia's top VC funds — which tells you something about the calibre of people who've looked closely at what we're building and said yes.

Our customers include some of the largest telehealth, fintech, and marketplace companies in the US and Australia — many handling over a million support tickets a year. The problems are real, the scale is real, and the work matters.

If you want to build something that genuinely changes how businesses and customers interact — this is the place.

Not seeing the right job for you just yet?

We’d still love to hear from you! If you’re exceptional at what you do and excited about Lorikeet, pitch us a role. Tell us how your skills could make an impact here, and we’ll be in touch if there’s a great fit -- now or in the future.

We’re particularly excited by:

  • Multidisciplinary talent – Designers who code, PMs who design, marketers who close deals, accountants who build functions from scratch.

  • Proven excellence in demanding environments – Rapid promotions at top startups, early promotions in consulting, founders who have built and scaled businesses.

Think you can add something special to Lorikeet? We'd love to hear from you.

What's unique about this opportunity?


A culture that's genuinely different. Low ego, high trust, no tolerance for talented jerks. We work efficiently, keep hours flexible, and actually mean it — because life outside work matters. We're committed to building a diverse team and actively encourage applicants from underrepresented backgrounds. We care far more about user obsession and eagerness to learn than traditional credentials.

A front-row seat to building something meaningful. We're Series A and moving fast. You'll have real scope to shape the product and the company — not just execute someone else's vision.

Performance recognized in real time, not on a calendar. Promotions happen when you're ready — leadership meets every six weeks specifically to identify and recognize strong performers, so you're never waiting for an arbitrary review window to move up.

We're AI-native, and we'll make you AI-native too. Every person at Lorikeet uses AI in their day-to-day work (current favourite: Claude Code), with unrestricted access and no usage limits. You'll leave with skills that matter for the next decade of work.

Twice a year, the whole company flies to Hawaii. Headquartered in Sydney, with teams spanning the US and UK — which means getting everyone in the same place is something we invest in seriously. We spend the time hacking on ideas, building things together that wouldn't otherwise exist, and making memories that remind you why you joined a startup in the first place.

A recruitment process built on respect, not hoops. We keep it simple: a couple of informal chats to share our story and hear yours, followed by a paid ~two-day work trial. The work trial is genuinely the best part — you'll work on real problems alongside the actual team, get a true feel for how we operate, and we'll both come out of it knowing whether this is the right fit. No trick questions, no take-homes that disappear into a void. Just real work, done together.

If you're from an underrepresented background and don't tick every box, please reach out anyway. We know firsthand that diverse teams perform better, and we're proud that our team reflects a broad spectrum of identities and lived experiences.

  • Excited about AI and can effectively communicate its transformative potential to complex businesses

  • Naturally curious about customers' business challenges and motivated to find the right solutions

  • Comfortable selling to technical and business stakeholders in enterprise organizations

  • Motivated by impact and wants to play a key role in an early-stage, fast-moving startup

  • Own the full sales cycle for enterprise prospects, from prospecting to closing deals

  • Develop deep understanding of customer support operations and articulate how Lorikeet's AI can transform them

  • Partner with our product and implementation teams to ensure smooth customer onboarding

  • Build and nurture relationships with key decision-makers at target accounts

  • Collaborate with sales leaders and founders to refine our value proposition and sales messaging

  • Meet and exceed revenue targets through both new customer acquisition and expansion

  • Have 5+ years of experience in new business / acquisition enterprise SaaS sales, ideally in B2B software or AI-driven solutions

  • Are comfortable with complex, consultative sales cycles and selling to multiple stakeholders

  • Can effectively communicate technical concepts and ROI to both technical and business audiences

You'll work on high-stakes, glamorous problems and unglamorous work that requires high diligence, high judgement, and high grind — but with unlimited scope for impact and access to AI tooling to help you operate at a higher level.

At leading tech startups, the strongest operators started as sharp generalists — often from consulting or entrepreneurial backgrounds — who embedded with founders, took on whatever the business needed, and built deep context along the way. Many went on to build entire functions and teams.

That's the opportunity here. Presenting to our company's leaders teaches you how decisions get made. Prepping an investor call teaches you how fundraising works. Taking things off our founders' plates teaches you what matters most. The exposure compounds. This role sits in the BizOps team, and we'd expect folks to graduate into that team after 1–2 years — where current members are serving as Chief of Staff, Head of Ecosystem Partnerships, GTM Engineering, and Head of RevOps.

About you

You're a sharp, curious generalist with 2–4 years in consulting, finance, or a fast-growing startup — someone who thrives in ambiguity, takes ownership instinctively, and never lets a thread drop. You understand that operational excellence is a craft, not a stepping stone, and you're genuinely excited by the messy, high-stakes work of building a company.

  • You're exceptionally organised, agency-driven, and as comfortable diving into an unfamiliar domain as you are managing a dozen open workstreams at once

  • You're in it for the game — not the CV — and you're ready to be in our Surry Hills office five days a week, working directly alongside our founders and leadership team

What you'll do

Run the operational engine behind our founders and leadership forums

  • Assist with LT agenda prep, brief founders on key discussion points, capture action items, and chase them to closure

  • Research and brief founders before investor calls, executive sessions, and board meetings

  • Coordinate logistics for events with guests (subscriber and prospect executive sponsors, special guests in tech): agenda, prep materials, debrief notes

  • Triage the stream of requests that land on the founders' plates: own it, route it, or make the call to drop it

  • Fill in where needed: run an exec demo, stand in at a conference, jump in to resolve a subscriber issue

Build systems and drive cross-functional clarity

  • Stand up new processes from scratch, then hand them off to the right function once they're running

  • Bring clarity to complex, cross-functional problems: pull together the right people, synthesise conflicting inputs, and help drive to a decision

  • Build scalable processes and playbooks, often with AI-native tooling that supercharges our founders' impact

Go deep on the business

  • Build genuine domain expertise: understand the Lorikeet platform well enough to demo it to a prospect, review tickets, and spot patterns across subscriber accounts

  • Communicate the business to varied audiences: write clearly for investors, present credibly to the leadership team, and translate strategy for the broader company

  • Develop a working knowledge of deals in the CRM, competitive landscape, and product roadmap — not as a spectator, but as someone who can identify issues with conviction

Grow by going deeper

  • The best operators here don't wait for learning opportunities: they go find them. Sit in on subscriber calls, read the board paper, attend product demos, dig into the data

  • Build enough understanding of the system to spot problems before anyone asks you to look

  • This is how people in this role grow into leading teams, owning functions, or stepping into BizOps, Chief of Staff, or other leadership roles

You might be a fit if you:

  • Have 2–4 years of experience in operations, strategy, consulting, investment banking, VC/PE, or a business analyst role at a fast-growing company

  • Come from a consulting, finance, entrepreneurial, or startup background where you learned to operate under ambiguity with hustle and horsepower

  • Are happy to be in our Surry Hills office 5 days/week and ready to hit the ground running

What's unique about this opportunity?


A culture that's genuinely different. Low ego, high trust, no tolerance for talented jerks. We work efficiently, keep hours flexible, and actually mean it — because life outside work matters. We're committed to building a diverse team and actively encourage applicants from underrepresented backgrounds. We care far more about user obsession and eagerness to learn than traditional credentials.

A front-row seat to building something meaningful. We're Series A and moving fast. You'll have real scope to shape the product and the company — not just execute someone else's vision.

Performance recognized in real time, not on a calendar. Promotions happen when you're ready — leadership meets every six weeks specifically to identify and recognize strong performers, so you're never waiting for an arbitrary review window to move up.

We're AI-native, and we'll make you AI-native too. Every person at Lorikeet uses AI in their day-to-day work (current favourite: Claude Code), with unrestricted access and no usage limits. You'll leave with skills that matter for the next decade of work.

Twice a year, the whole company flies to Hawaii. Headquartered in Sydney, with teams spanning the US and UK — which means getting everyone in the same place is something we invest in seriously. We spend the time hacking on ideas, building things together that wouldn't otherwise exist, and making memories that remind you why you joined a startup in the first place.

A recruitment process built on respect, not hoops. We keep it simple: a couple of informal chats to share our story and hear yours, followed by a paid ~two-day work trial. The work trial is genuinely the best part — you'll work on real problems alongside the actual team, get a true feel for how we operate, and we'll both come out of it knowing whether this is the right fit. No trick questions, no take-homes that disappear into a void. Just real work, done together.

If you're from an underrepresented background and don't tick every box, please reach out anyway. We know firsthand that diverse teams perform better, and we're proud that our team reflects a broad spectrum of identities and lived experiences.

jobs.title: Strategic Finance
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

Lorikeet is redefining what customer support looks like — and we're just getting started.

We build AI that handles complex, high-volume support for fintechs, healthtechs, marketplaces, and delivery services. Not chatbot-tier AI. The kind that actually resolves tickets, gives support teams their time back, and raises the bar for what software can do.

We're backed by over $50M USD from QED, Blackbird, and Square Peg, with backing from operators like Claire Hughes Johnson (ex-Stripe COO) and Cristina Cordova (Linear COO), plus founders of Canva, Atlassian, and Airwallex. We're the first company since Canva to be funded at early stage by all three of Australia's top VC funds — which tells you something about the calibre of people who've looked closely at what we're building and said yes.

Our customers include some of the largest telehealth, fintech, and marketplace companies in the US and Australia — many handling over a million support tickets a year. The problems are real, the scale is real, and the work matters.

If you want to build something that genuinely changes how businesses and customers interact — this is the place.

About the role

We're hiring a Strategic Finance member to own the financial systems, models, and insights that guide our business.

You'll work closely with our founders, operations, and go-to-market teams to turn multi-channel inputs into clean signals. That means owning forecasts, partnering on headcount planning, tracking performance against goals, and helping us understand where the business is working and where we can do better. Part strategic advisor, part hands-on operator, you'll help refine the systems that keep us informed and aligned as we scale.

As our only in-house finance team member, you'll have the opportunity to set the strategy for our strategic finance function and define how we do things—a real growth opportunity for someone who wants to drive and build something from the ground up.


About You

We're looking for a strategic finance professional to help us accelerate our growth. This role is perfect for someone who:

  • Gets genuinely excited about AI and can communicate its transformative potential to complex businesses. You see what's coming and know how to bring others along.

  • Is naturally curious about data and what it reveals. You love digging into numbers not just to report them, but to find the story underneath and figure out what it means for the business.

  • Has a builder's mindset — you get energy from creating systems, models, and processes from scratch. You want to design the way we do things, not just inherit them.

  • Can translate complex financial analysis into clear, actionable insights for founders, operators, and investors who aren't living in the spreadsheets.

  • Is motivated by impact and eager to play a key role at an early-stage, fast-moving startup where your work shapes real decisions.


What you'll do

  • Own financial models, operating plans, and scenario planning for the business

  • Partner with teams on headcount planning, budgeting, and investment tradeoffs

  • Track revenue, costs, and margin drivers—and highlight what's changing

  • Build and maintain internal dashboards and reporting systems

  • Support pricing, forecasting, and board/investor communications

  • Work cross-functionally to bring financial rigor to product, GTM, and operational decisions

  • Lead strategic initiatives and special projects—from marketing ROI analysis to vendor negotiations and other high-impact business decisions

  • Spot areas where we're flying blind and bring structure to them


The right candidate

We need someone with strong financial instincts who thrives in ambiguity and can influence decision-making cross-functionally. As the only in-house finance team member, you'll have the agency to take initiative on the mechanisms that ensure our growth and success, thoughtfully adapting those mechanisms as business needs change.


You might be a fit if you:

  • Have 5-7 years of experience in strategic finance, PE, investment banking, or early-stage operating roles, with a track record of partnering closely with leadership to drive financial clarity and decision-making, or a CFA.

  • Have built and maintained operating models used for real-world planning ideally in a SaaS or B2B start up environment

  • Have owned or directly contributed to board reporting, headcount planning, or annual planning cycles

  • Have demonstrated experience modeling ARR, CAC, burn ratios and other SaaS metrics that actually matter

  • Have experience designing internal reporting, dashboards, or planning rituals that stuck

  • Have worked cross-functionally to pressure-test investments, run scenario analyses, or improve unit economics

  • Are excited by the chance to help build a category-defining AI company

What's unique about this opportunity?


A culture that's genuinely different. Low ego, high trust, no tolerance for talented jerks. We work efficiently, keep hours flexible, and actually mean it — because life outside work matters. We're committed to building a diverse team and actively encourage applicants from underrepresented backgrounds. We care far more about user obsession and eagerness to learn than traditional credentials.

A front-row seat to building something meaningful. We're Series A and moving fast. You'll have real scope to shape the product and the company — not just execute someone else's vision.

Performance recognized in real time, not on a calendar. Promotions happen when you're ready — leadership meets every six weeks specifically to identify and recognize strong performers, so you're never waiting for an arbitrary review window to move up.

We're AI-native, and we'll make you AI-native too. Every person at Lorikeet uses AI in their day-to-day work (current favourite: Claude Code), with unrestricted access and no usage limits. You'll leave with skills that matter for the next decade of work.

Twice a year, the whole company flies to Hawaii. Headquartered in Sydney, with teams spanning the US and UK — which means getting everyone in the same place is something we invest in seriously. We spend the time hacking on ideas, building things together that wouldn't otherwise exist, and making memories that remind you why you joined a startup in the first place.

A recruitment process built on respect, not hoops. We keep it simple: a couple of informal chats to share our story and hear yours, followed by a paid ~two-day work trial. The work trial is genuinely the best part — you'll work on real problems alongside the actual team, get a true feel for how we operate, and we'll both come out of it knowing whether this is the right fit. No trick questions, no take-homes that disappear into a void. Just real work, done together.

If you're from an underrepresented background and don't tick every box, please reach out anyway. We know firsthand that diverse teams perform better, and we're proud that our team reflects a broad spectrum of identities and lived experiences.
